why: Opening Customize repaints the rings through `renderSelection`, and before any choice is stored that is the only thing that marks a row at all. Dropping the accent row leaves it with no ring. Every `hud.controls.test.ts` Customize case stores a choice first, and a store repaints its own row, so under this mutation all 116 tests in hud.controls.test.ts and hud.a11y.test.ts passed (local control run while issue #556 was open). The direct case asks for the default ring in every row.
killedBy: renderCustomizeChoices (issue #556) renderSelection marks the first entry of EVERY row when nothing has been stored
